column1: # class\towner: the exceptions to red.sh's family rule. red.sh routes a class by its mechanism-family
# prefix (its `family()`); a line here names a class that family gets wrong. A class is the census
# miss with any `: detail` dropped; a `program:<path>` line overrides the owner for that program,
# `program:<path>@<unit>` for one unit of it, and `fallback:<reason>` for one fallback reason.
declaration if per arm scalar link
field read of a stored row's box
integer negation of a valued if
null name test of a non-name null side
null name test of a null side that stores
store of an assignment of null into a null local
fallback:ref valtype with no interned shape
fallback:slotless local at a rep with no valtype
